title: Battle of Plassey
summary: Clive’s East India Company force, with Indian allies, defeats Siraj-ud-Daulah and opens Bengal to Company rule.

title: Seven Years’ War
summary: A global war among European powers redraws North America, the Caribbean, and India.

title: Watt’s separate condenser patent
summary: James Watt patents a more efficient steam engine, a key piece of industrial power technology.

title: Cook on the east coast of Australia
summary: James Cook charts the east coast of Australia and claims it for Britain, ignoring existing Aboriginal sovereignty.

title: Declaration of Independence
summary: Thirteen colonies declare independence from Britain in a document that became a global political text.

title: The Wealth of Nations
summary: Adam Smith publishes an inquiry into the nature and causes of the wealth of nations.

title: Siege of Yorktown
summary: Franco-American forces trap Cornwallis at Yorktown, effectively winning the War of Independence.

title: French Revolution begins
summary: The Bastille falls and a revolutionary crisis in France becomes a European turning point.

title: Haitian Revolution begins
summary: Enslaved people in Saint-Domingue rise, beginning the only successful slave revolution to found a lasting state.

title: Execution of Louis XVI
summary: The French Republic guillotines the former king, internationalizing the revolution.

title: Jenner’s smallpox vaccination
summary: Edward Jenner demonstrates cowpox inoculation as protection against smallpox.

title: Battle of the Nile
summary: Nelson destroys the French fleet at Aboukir Bay, stranding Bonaparte’s Egyptian expedition.

title: 18 Brumaire
summary: Bonaparte’s coup ends the Directory and opens the Consulate.

title: British Empire (union to late decolonization)
summary: A long context bar from the Union of 1707 to the handover of Hong Kong.
